decision_reason: The persisted 120-second backoff and exact not_before survived the invocation boundary unchanged. After eligibility, the synthetic forecast-overrun control set remaining budget to 1000 seconds while forecast_p90 + retry_reserve = 1200 seconds. The plan generation advanced monotonically 1->2 and switched once to compact_plan without consuming another external-work attempt or resampling backoff.
stale_generation_rule: Any continuation carrying plan_generation < 2 is stale and must not reactivate the prior plan; repository writes must use the current content blob as CAS authority.
next_invocation_rule: Reconstruct this exact generation-2 state from the canonical role branch and do not re-switch solely because the same overrun evidence is replayed. Separately preserve retry-budget exhaustion as an independent cause: at retry_attempt=max_attempts with forecast_overrun=false, blind retry must be rejected and the control must switch/defer/block without consuming an external-work attempt.
quota_zero_assessment: No hosted runner, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package, cloud/model credit, protected-primary merge, or manual execution step is used. State transport is lightweight repository text only.
